name: com.ratetrove/mcp
title: RateTrove
description: Use search_deposit_rates for US credit union deposit rates verified within 48 hours. No key needed.

tools.name: search_deposit_rates
tools.description: U.S. credit union deposit products verified against the source page in the last 48 hours, ranked by calculated APY on a $10,000 balance (max 10). Results use the calculated APY on a $10,000 balance, with products whose known opening minimum exceeds $10,000 placed last.

min_apy.description: Minimum ADVERTISED APY (the issuer's stated rate, not the calculated APY on $10,000)
